title: This Chinese Carbon Frame is Almost Perfect…

takeaways.text: The largest size, 58 cm, weighed 1,236 g; the US$950 package includes frame, fork, seatpost, integrated bar, headset, axles, T47 bottom bracket, Di2 holder and storage bag, about US$1,100 with shipping.
Paint, masking, faced bottom-bracket shell, threads, brake mounts and bearing seats were all clean; the 38 cm × 110 mm bar weighed about 327 g.
An endoscope showed a very clean latex-mandrel interior except a patch under 2 cm² of loose fibres inside the seat tube near the seatstay junction, which LightCarbon called non-structural.
LightCarbon offered a replacement, then tightened QC at its mandrel supplier and began endoscope-checking every frame; for customers it says it would offer a partial refund or a replacement.

disclosure: LightCarbon supplied the frameset for review without payment; the video carries an unrelated clothing sponsorship.
summary: Inspection of a size-58 LightCarbon LCR018-D aero all-road frameset, including an internal fibre defect and the maker's response.
